items.text: Bikashangwa bisigaireyo ebiro bibili kugoba Pasika n'ekiro kikuru ky'emikate etatumbisiibwe. Abakuhani bakuru n'abegesa b'Amateka bahiga kukwata Yesu atabamanyire, bakamwita.
Bagambaga bati, “Tutamukwatira mu kiro kikuru, embaga etaija ekatuhyokera.”
Yesu kayabaire ali Betania omwa Simoni omubembe nalya, omukazi aija n'echupa y'eibare einamu amajuta g'eiguzi lihango muno, ahenda echupa egyo engoto, amusheshera amajuta omu mutwe.
Kyonkai haliho abatamirwe bakatekeleza bati, “Amajuta aga gafaki?
Gakuguziibwe garugwamu edinari ezilikushaaga 300, zigabirwa aboro.”
Kyonkai Yesu agamba ati, “Mumuleke; kiki kumwita kubi? Ekyo yankolera kirungi.
Manya ebiro byona abanaku mwinabo; nimushobora kubajuna mbali mwayendera. Kyonkai inye timulikwija kumbona biro byona.
Yakora ekyo yashobora. Omubili gwange yagusiiga amajuta likyali karai nagutekatekera kuziikwa.
Mara mbagambiire amazima, eky'omukazi ogu yakora balimwijuka nibakibarura.”
Aho Yuda Isikariote, omoi omu 12, agya omu bakuhani bakuru kumubanja.
Kabahuliire batyo bashemelerwa, baragana kumuha empiha. Kwema aho Yuda ata nahiga obushango bw'okumubanja.
Aha kiro kya mbere ky'Omukate Gutatumbisiibwe, ekyo batambiragaho akataama ka Pasika, abegesibwabe bamugambira bati, “Wakugondize tugyehai kukutekatekera mbali oraliira Pasika?”
Omu begesibwabe atumamu babili, abagambira ati, “Mugye omu kigo, muratanganwamu omushaija ayetwekire emuga y'amaizi. Mumuhondere,
mbali arataha, mugambire nyin'enju muti, ‘Omwegesa nabaza eikumbi mbali araliira Pasika hamoi n'abegesibwabe.’
Araboleka ekiyumba omu gorofa, kitekatekire kihoire; omwo mube nimwo mutushemeleza.”
Abegesibwa baturuka bataha omu kigo, babibona okwo yabagambira, batekateka Pasika.
Eizoba kalyatobeire Yesu aija n'eikumi na babili.
Kababaire bali aha meza nibalya, Yesu agamba ati, “Mbagambiire amazima, omuli inywe halimu arambanja, mara nitulya hamoi.”
Babanza kujunara buli omoi namubaza ati, “Isi n'inye?”
Yesu abagambira ati, “N'omoiho omu 12, nitukoza hamoi omukate aha sahani.
Omwana w'Omuntu nibija kumubaho nk'okwo bywamuhandikirweho, kyonkai alibona ogwo alikwija kubanja Omwana w'Omuntu! Hakili k'omuntu ogwo atakuzairwe.”
Kababaire nibalya, akwata omukate, asiima, agubegura, agubaha nagamba ati, “Tora, ogu mubili gwange.”
Akwata n'ekikompe, kayamazire kusiima akibaha, bona bakinywaho.
Abagambira ati, “Obu bwamba bwange obw'endagano empya, obwo barashesha kuchungura bangi.
Mbagambiire amazima, tinkishuba kunywa divai kuhika orwo ndinywa empya omu bukama bwa Tata.”
Kabamazire kuhoya oruhoya, baturuka bagenda aha Ibanga ly'Emizeituni.
Yesu agambira abegesibwabe ati, “Nimwija kwiruka inywena mukannagaho. Enshonga kikahandikwa kiti,
Bakwata omuhanda bagya mbali hayetwaga Getisameni. Yesu agambira abegesibwabe ati, “Mushuntame aha mbe ninshoma enshara.”
Aihyaho Petero na Yakobo na Yohana agenda nabo, aho abanza kugira obushasi bungi n'okushoberwa muno.
Agambira abashatu aba ati, “Omwoyo gwange gwina obujune bungi muno kuralira kufa. Musigare aha mara mutanagira.”
Ailirayo akandi kake, ajumara ahansi, ashaba ati, “Tata, kakiraba nikishoboka esaa egi empingure.”
Ashuba agamba ati, “Aba. Tata, ebintu byona ahali iwe nibishoboka. Banyihyeho ekikompe eki. Kyonkai tikwo inye ndikwenda, iwe okwo olikwenda obe nikwo okora.”
Aija ashanga okwo banagiire, abaza Petero ati, “Simoni, wanagira? Tiwashobora kurora saa emoi yonkai?
Otanagira, oshome enshara otaija okagwa omu bilengeso. Mazima omwoyo nigwenda, kyonkai obunyama bujege.”
Ashubayo ashoma enshara, ashubamu ebigambo byonene.
Agaruka ashanga okwo banagiire, nobona oturo tukabakiza amani. Eky'okumuhorora tibakiiboine.
Aija omurundi gwa kashatu abagambira ati, “Mukyanagiire kuhumura? Otwo mwanagira nitumara; esaa yagoba, Omwana w'Omuntu yabanzirwe, yanagirwe omu mikono y'abafakare.
Mwimuke tube nitugenda, leba embanzi yagoba.”
Orwo Yesu yabaire akyagamba ebyo, lileta Yuda, omoiho omu 12, aija n'embaga eina embanda n'erungu ebyo babaire bahairwe abakuhani bakuru na'abegesa b'Amateka n'abagurusi.
Embanzi ekaba ebahaire akabonero negamba eti, “Owo ndanywegera n'iwe; mumukwate mara mumutware nimumanya.”
Yuda kayaizire talinda, amugoba, agamba ati, “Mwegesa!” Amunywegera.
Bamutaho engaro bamukwata.
Kyonkai omuli balinya abashangirwe bemeleire haihi, omoiho ahurutura embanda omu kiraro, atema omwiru w'Omukuhani Nyamukuru okutwi.
Yesu ababaza ati, “Mwaija n'embanda n'erungu kunkwata okwobon'oti muzinzire omushuga?
Ebiro byona tuba tuli hamoi Rwensinga n'inyegesa, timukankwataga. Kyonkai k'ebihandiko bitakatifu bigobelere.”
Aho abegesibwa bona bamusigaho bairuka.
Hakaba haliho omusigazi ahondeire Yesu atajwete, shana aha mubili ayenagireho akendo ka kitaani; bamukwata.
Kyonkai wenene abasigira akendo ka kitaani airuka ali bushai.
Yesu bamutwalira Omukuhani Nyamukuru; aho abakuhani bakuru bona n'abagurusi n'abegesa b'Amateka literaine.
Petero agenda namuhondera ayemire harai, alemwa agoba nyakabuga omw'Omukuhani Nyamukuru. Ashuntama n'abalinzi, ayota omuliro.
Aho abakuhani bakuru n'orukiiko rwona bahanyanyia omushango gw'okutaho Yesu kumwita, kyonkai byanga.
Bangi bamuhangilira kyonkai ebyo bamuhangilira byanga kushushana.
Abandi bemelera bamuhangilira bati,
“Tukamuhulira nagamba okwo arakambura Rwensinga eyayombekirwe abantu, ayombeke endijo omu biro bishatu, mara atagyombekesize bantu.”
Nabyo ebyo tibyafire kushushangana.
Omukuhani Nyamukuru ayemelera omu rukiiko omugati, abaza Yesu ati, “Iwe toina kyakuhorora? Aba nibakutoijeleraki?”
Kyonkai Yesu ayesiza, tiyahoroire. Omukuhani Nyamukuru ashuba amubaza ati, “N'iwe Kirisito Omwana wa Nyakusinga?”
Yesu agamba ati, “Ndiwe, mara nimwija kubona Omwana w'Omuntu asingiire aha bulyo bw'Omushobora, naletwa omu bichwi.”
Omukuhani Nyamukuru atagura ebijwarobye, agamba ati, “Obujulizi tukyahiiga obwaki?
Mwahulira okwo yarogota. Nimuramuraki?” Bona bamuramura okwo alikuragirwa.
Nikwo abandi kubanza kumuchwera ebichwanta, kumubunda amaisho, kumutera, nibagamba bati, “Toma!” Abalinzi nabo bamutamu empi.
Petero akaba ali nyakabuga amagyaifo, aijwa omuzana omoi w'Omukuhani Nyamukuru.
Kayaboine Petero nayota omuliro, amuhanga amaisho, agamba ati, “Naiwe waba oina Yesu Omunazareti.”
Petero ayetonga ekigambo ekyo ati, “Tindikumanya by'olikugamba anga kubishobokerwa!” Aho aturuka agya nyarubuga n'enkoko ekokoroma.
Omuzana amuboine, ashuba abanza kugambira ababaire bali aho ati, “Omushaija ogu nawe mumoi wabo.”
Petero ashuba ayetonga ekigambo ekyo. Akaanya kakahingwireho kake n'ababaire bali aho bagambira Petero bati, “Ky'amazima iwe oli mumoi wabo; aha rw'okuba oli Munyagalilaya.”
Kyonkai Petero abanza kuraapa n'okurahira ati, “Omuntu ogu owo mulikugamba inye tindikumumanya.”
Niho honkai ekoko ekokoroma elya kabili. Nirwo Petero yaijukire okwo Yesu yabaire amugambiire ati, “Enkoko etakakokoromire kabili oraba wanyetongire kashatu.” Aho atekeleza ekigambo ekyo, alira.
